items.title: Adobe Max 2026 Live Updates: All the AI, Photo and Video News - CNET
items.summary: The biggest changes are the general release of AI assistants in Photoshop, Adobe Express and its AI hub, Firefly, first teased at last year’s conference. These assistants are similar to chatbots, where you enter your request and the AI does the editing for you. Adobe also released AI music generation tools and new photo editing modes. For video editors, too, there are the new Premiere mobile apps. [...] Adobe tech is also now showing up in ChatGPT and Claude; Disney is using Firefly to help design theme park rides. And from what CNET has heard from Adobe execs, the company isn’t planning to slow down its AI research any time soon. [...] Adobe’s flagship programs, like Photoshop, have undergone major AI makeovers, including recent developments like AI audio and soundtrack generation. This has been to the dismay of some of its creative customers who are wary of generative AI. This year is expected to be no different. But there are other tensions brewing, including Adobe’s $75 million settlement with the US Justice Department over subscription cancellations and new vibe-coded and free Adobe alternatives.

items.title: With new Democratic Congress incoming, Pritzker calls for federal AI regulations | Capitol News Illinois
items.summary:
Currently, no comprehensive federal regulatory framework exists. Trump signed an executive order in September to rename AI “Super Intelligence” and created a White House accord on Super Intelligence with the leaders of OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google, XAI and Nvidia. [...] This month, Anthropic registered for its initial public offering, but almost a third of its securities filing to potential investors focused on the routine and extraordinary risks the company’s models could pose.

Scott Wisor, policy director at the Secure AI Project, said the risks fall into two buckets: malicious use by users who know how to ask AI a question and use it to do harm, and systems not acting the way developers intended. [...] Stokes said ensuring a company stays compliant across states with varied regulatory frameworks is one reason the CCIA has pushed for a federal solution to AI legislation.

### Why is AI regulation needed?

Last month, a former Anthropic and OpenAI researcher alleged that AI companies are building a tool that could threaten human existence by the end of the decade.

items.title: Google faces mounting backlash for controversial AI school policy - CBS News
items.summary:
Markey is asking Alphabet if Google will commit to allowing schools to turn off AI features and chatbots in K-12 student accounts while still allowing students to access Google Search. He also requested that Google disclose any research it has conducted on the impact of its AI tools on students' mental health.

Markey has requested that Google disclose any research or testing it has conducted on the safety of its AI functions and their impact on the mental health of K-12 students. [...] Google maintains that its policy change gives schools more control over how they allow AI into schools. An Alphabet spokesperson also told CBS News that Google's AI features are now so tightly integrated into search that it cannot offer the latter without also enabling the AI services. [...] Google faces mounting public pressure to change a new policy that would limit U.S. students' access to the internet giant's widely used search platform unless schools also offer its artificial intelligence-based education tools.

In a letter to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai on Monday, Sen. Edward Markey demanded that Google's corporate parent reverse the policy, which blocks search for K-12 student accounts that don't also provide access to apps such as Google Classroom.

13:36 09/11/2026

iPhone Air 2 có thể có camera thứ 2, Samsung hé lộ smartphone màn hình trượt, trong khi chuyên gia Tencent cảnh báo nguy cơ AI bị lợi dụng để phát triển vũ khí sinh học là những tin công nghệ đáng chú ý ngày 9/11.

Mỗi học viên cần phấn đấu không chỉ sử dụng thành thạo công nghệ mà còn có khả năng tham mưu, đề xuất giải pháp, hướng dẫn đồng nghiệp, trở thành lực lượng nòng cốt thúc đẩy chuyển đổi số tại địa phương.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”
